items.title: How does this astrologer live such a life of luxury? I travel hack, girlies
items.summary:
How does this astrologer live such a life of luxury?

I travel hack, girlies. 💅 

I strategize. I move my points around. I spend intentionally. I get super cheap flight upgrades often using a combination of electional astrology and travel hacking. 

I’m not just an astrologer. I’m an entrepreneur. Went to School of Hard Knocks and learned by living it. 

I started learning about traveling hacking in 2013 and began using travel credit card rewards systems to be able to fund my travels. I was 19, poor, living in NYC and the dream was to backpack Europe alone for 2 months. Buuuut I was serving tables and babysitting and could barely afford to pay my rent. 🫠

So I got scrappy. And one of the ways I was able to achieve my dream of traveling internationally was starting to accumulate travel rewards points. 

💳MARIOTT BONVOY credit cards are my favorite if you prioritize luxury hotel stays in your travels. 

If you love checking out late, room service, spa services and the absolute best service imaginable, Marriot Bonvoy beats out Hilton Honors and World of Hyatt. 

💳 I have and use all 3 cards but Marriott Bonvoy is the best, especially if you like free suite upgrades, free spa treatments, and the beeeeest luxury hotel brands. 

🤩It took 2 YEARS to hit this goal with Marriott Bonvoy. But it finally happened. Found out and got the notification when the moon was conjunct the north node 🤓

🎯 I love a goal. I love working toward a goal. And I love hitting the goal. And I recently hit my goal of getting to Platinum status. 

I was sooooooo close to hitting it a year ago. And then…I failed right before the deadline. 😖

But what that gave me was so much DRIVE and motivation to hit it the following year. 

Achieving a goal is the sweetest, most delicious feeling. 🍭🍬

If you’re ready to start using travel reward points, travel hacking and astrology to get everything you want in life with traveling and living around the world like I do, comment “OFFICE” I’m teaching you live this December ⤵️

items.title: Overlapping Planetary Periods in Astrology
items.summary:
Nick Dagan Best joins me to discuss overlapping planetary periods, and how the repeating cycles of the visible planets align at specific milestone ages in a human life to create powerful recurrence transits.

While I've spent a lot of time over the past few years researching the eight-year cycle of Venus retrogrades on its own, some repetitions stand out as much more significant than others, because they coincide with the returning cycles of other planets at specific ages like 24, 32, 40, 47, 56, and 59.

This is kind of a free flowing discussion where we animate charts to demonstrate how these multi-planet alignments work astronomically, and also examine how they play out in both mundane events and natal biographies.

We also explore how these recurring planetary cycles formed the empirical foundation for ancient Mesopotamian goal year periods and Hellenistic time-lord systems, while offering some practical insights into how modern astrologers can apply them in birth chart consultations or even chart rectification.

This is episode 556 of The Astrology Podcast.
